entities.name: Ariosa
entities.description: A villager of Lambholt on Innistrad, daughter of Arinos, who appears to be an occultist involved in summoning Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Arinos
entities.description: Ariosa's superstitious father who summoned Old Stickfingers and disappeared; his corpse was never found.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: A supernatural being summoned by ritual that went on a killing spree in Lambholt.

entities.name: Dein Salvasi
entities.description: Wealthy neighbor of Arinos who tried to seize his home.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: Investigator who, with Rem Karolus, looked into the killings.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Village on Innistrad terrorized by Old Stickfingers.

events.summary: Arinos summons Old Stickfingers to protect his home from Dein Salvasi; the ritual goes wrong and Arinos disappears while murders begin.
events.quote: This dark ritual went wrong, leading to Arinos's disappearance

events.summary: Vadrik and Rem begin investigating and link Old Stickfingers to Ariosa's father; Ariosa gives Vadrik information.
events.quote: Ariosa provided crucial information to Vadrik

events.summary: Vadrik and Rem destroy the mobile used in the summoning, which only unbinds Stickfingers from its hearth.
events.quote: destroying the mobile used in the summoning ritual

events.summary: Ariosa performs the second part of the ritual, specifying Stickfingers should kill only those she marks; she knows all the words of the poem.
events.quote: Ariosa knew all the words of the poem that needed to be recited

events.summary: Old Stickfingers takes his goats and vanishes into the woods; Vadrik and Rem leave Lambholt, troubled by two made beds and a green glow.
events.quote: Old Stickfingers took his goats and vanished into the woods

relations.quote: When the two men began their investigation

relations.note: tension over Salvasi seizing his home
